Perfect — thanks Alice. Marissa/Jonas, can we propose a simple three-step reconciliation so both sides have clear ownership and routing? My draft:
1) Joint account inventory sign-off (owners + stage) — deadline EOD Wed
2) For conflicts, apply rule-set: if Cobalt has contract/PO in place -> Cobalt primary; if Redwood has active POC/live pilot -> Redwood primary; otherwise default to co-sell and assign an action owner.
3) Map technical integration owners and pilot scope (one page MLP) and agree on mutually visible milestones.

I'm happy to host a 30-min call Wed 11am PT to run the sign-off. Jonas — could you prepare a mapping view of account-stage to help triage?

Thanks,
Ben
